name: currency-api

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Verifies the gateway's signed assertion for every request from currency-webapp.

dependencies.name: exchange-rate-service
dependencies.description: Fetches the current exchange rate for the requested currency pair when converting an amount.

description: Ballerina service exposing the supported currency list and a conversion operation. Calls exchange-rate-service for the current rate on each conversion; does not persist conversions or rate history.
